objective: Auditar en READ_ONLY_SQL el esquema canonico real de EDARSAHUB para iniciar EDARSAHUB BOS Primary Industries. Identificar entidades, relaciones, llaves, vistas y capacidades ya existentes que puedan reutilizarse o extenderse para agricultura, ganaderia, avicultura, porcicultura, pesca, acuicultura, silvicultura, granos, apicultura y otros giros del sector primario. Producir evidencia suficiente para clasificar REUTILIZAR / EXTENDER / HUECO_REAL sin ejecutar DDL ni DML.
acceptance: status PASS para todos los checks READ_ONLY_SQL o blockers explicitos con evidencia
inventario de objetos candidatos por dominio
columnas, tipos, PK/FK e indices relevantes de los objetos candidatos

deteccion de capacidades canonicas de empresa, unidad organizacional/productiva, inventario, almacen, lote, compras, proveedores, costos, activos, mantenimiento, personal, geografia, calidad, produccion, trazabilidad, documentos, workflows, RBAC, calendarios, zonas horarias, monedas e idiomas
constraints: EDARSAHUB SQL Server es la fuente canonica
No Mongo como fuente operativa o de verdad
No hardcode de IDs, empresas, unidades, monedas, idiomas, zonas horarias o reglas sectoriales
No crear tablas ni modificar esquema
No duplicar catalogos o entidades existentes
Aplicar principio descubrir -> reutilizar -> extender -> crear solo lo faltante
Respetar RBAC y estructura multiempresa existente
No tocar Scheduler, NetPay ni Produccion

queries.name: primary_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) s.name AS schema_name, o.type_desc, o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%activo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%manten%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%personal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%ubic%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%geo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%calidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%produ%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%traza%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%document%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%workflow%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%calend%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%moneda%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%idioma%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%zona%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%agric%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%ganad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%avic%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%porc%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%pesca%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%acuic%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%forest%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%grano%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%apiar%') ORDER BY s.name, o.type_desc, o.name;

queries.name: primary_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (2000) s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%activo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%manten%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%personal%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%ubic%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%geo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%calidad%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%produ%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%traza%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%document%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%workflow%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%calend%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%moneda%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%idioma%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%zona%') ORDER BY s.name, t.name, c.column_id;

queries.name: primary_candidate_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) schp.name AS parent_schema, tp.name AS parent_table, cp.name AS parent_column, fk.name AS fk_name, schr.name AS referenced_schema, tr.name AS referenced_table, cr.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fk.object_id=fkc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.tables tp ON tp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schp ON schp.schema_id=tp.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cp ON cp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND cp.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables tr ON tr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schr ON schr.schema_id=tr.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cr ON cr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND cr.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%activo%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%manten%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%emple%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%personal%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%ubic%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%calidad%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%produ%' OR LOWER(tp.name) LIKE '%traza%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(tr.name) LIKE '%producto%' ORDER BY schp.name, tp.name, fk.name;

queries.name: primary_candidate_keys_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1500) s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_primary_key, i.is_unique, i.type_desc, c.name AS column_name, ic.key_ordinal, ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%invent%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%activo%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%manten%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%calidad%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%produ%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%traza%') ORDER BY s.name, t.name, i.index_id, ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: canonical_localization_and_time_fields
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1000) s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fecha%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%timezone%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%zona_hor%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%moneda%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%currency%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%idioma%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%locale%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%pais%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%unidad_med%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%uom%') ORDER BY s.name, t.name, c.column_id;

queries.name: canonical_security_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (750) s.name AS schema_name, o.type_desc, o.name AS object_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('U','V','P') AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%auth%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%access%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%empresa%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%usuario%') ORDER BY s.name, o.type_desc, o.name;
